subject: Preboarding attestation logistics + sample walkthrough
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@brightline.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Preboarding attestation exports and a quick walkthrough request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of Brightline's SOC 2 evidence collection we're looking to validate the preboarding attestation process (who signs, how we store signoffs, redaction practices). Can you share a sample export (CSV) of recent preboarding attestations (redacted PII) and a quick note on your redaction rules and chain-of-custody?

Specific asks:
- A CSV example of attestations (first name only, job role, attestation type, date/time, verifier id)
- Which vendor performs background checks and the contract name/PO if available
- Retention policy for attestations and training logs
- Who on your side owns the handoff for audit packages (email + phone)

If easier, we'd like a 20-min walkthrough this week. I can make space Thu/Fri morning PST.

Best,
Lina Torres
Director, Security Assurance
Brightline Health

Attachments: none

From: soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@brightline.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preboarding attestation exports and a quick walkthrough request

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (HR) and Jonas (Security Ops) who will assemble the artifacts. Quick responses inline:

- We can produce a redacted CSV sample; see filename we plan to attach: preboarding-attestations.csv (redacted sample).
- Background checks are run by ClearHire under our 2026 SOW (clearhire-SOW-2026.pdf). We will include the vendor contact and MSA reference.
- Retention: attestation records and training logs are retained for 5 years by default; access logs retained for 2 years. We keep a separate retention policy matrix — attaching onboarding-process-matrix.xlsx.
- Handoff owner: Laura Bennett (HR Compliance) will own the evidence package for this request; Vanessa Ortiz (Security Programs) is the escalation contact.

I can do a 20-min walkthrough Fri 12/24 9–11am PST or Mon 12/27 9–11am PST. Which works for you?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: preboarding-attestations.csv (redacted sample), onboarding-process-matrix.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@brightline.com>, soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preboarding attestation exports and a quick walkthrough request

Hi Lina + Soojin,

Attaching the redaction guidance we apply and a sample CSV (I've removed surnames, full DOBs, SSNs, phone numbers; we keep month/year only where required for verification). Notes below:

Redaction rules (summary):
- Replace last name with initial only (when internal review requires), drop SSN entirely, keep hire date as YYYY-MM-DD, DOB as YYYY-MM (month granularity).
- Verifier ID is internal employee id (redwood-emp-####); for vendor verifications we map to vendor reference id only.
- Chain-of-custody: attestations are captured via our onboarding portal, signed electronically, stored in an encrypted bucket with access restricted to HR+Security Ops. Audit export contains a hash and export timestamp; we include the export hash in the CSV footer.

I've attached training-rollup-2026.zip with anonymized completion logs (counts per role, no PII) and preboarding-attestations.csv (redacted).

If Brightline wants the unredacted records under an executed DPA+NDA we can route that request via Legal — otherwise redacted exports are standard for SOC 2 evidence.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, HR Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: preboarding-attestations.csv, training-rollup-2026.zip, clearhire-SOW-2026.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
To: Lina Torres <audit@brightline.com>, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 28 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preboarding attestation exports and a quick walkthrough request

Lina — a couple of operational notes so expectations are clear before the walkthrough: 

- Export provenance: we store the export hash in an S3 bucket with server-side encryption (KMS key: projects/redwood/evidence-2026). We will include the hash and S3 path in the package we hand over.
- Retention specifics: attestation records: 5 years; training transcripts (redacted) 3 years; logs (access, changes) 2 years. If Brightline's audit requires different retention windows for a sample set, we can generate a time-limited archive.
- Chain-of-custody handoff: we prefer to share a signed package via DocuSign that confirms the export hash and list of files. Example DocuSign link will be provided.

Internal note: I'll add a short README to the Drive folder that explains how to validate the export hash and which columns are redacted. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExample

Jonas Weber
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

Also please route the final package through DocuSign with a short attestation cover page that confirms redaction policy and retention windows.

If you can get that to us by EOD Thu 12/30 PST we will be able to include it in our evidence binder for the week.

Thanks,
Brightline Audit Team

Hi — thanks for the quick review and the requested change. We've added the attestation_method column to the redacted CSV and created a one-page attestation cover. I've initiated a DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/0a1b2c (cover page + export hash confirmation).

- clearhire-SOW-2026.pdf (vendor SOW)

Target delivery: Once DocuSign is complete we will send the signed package and Drive access link. Laura will own the package transfer and can be reached at laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com. If Brightline needs any unredacted items we will route through Legal as discussed.

Thanks and happy holidays,
Soojin Lee
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
